title: PARA Graph Core Architecture
summary: Core architecture of the hybrid code-knowledge graph: node schema (GraphNode with SemanticAttributes including docAnchors), edge schema (GraphEdge with confidence levels), two distinct traceability mechanisms (CSA Double-Binding for Specs, Graph Doc-Anchoring for Docs), SQLite storage layout (.beads/graph/), Memory Engine (events + semantic slices), Project Insights (lessons/risks/patterns), and L2 File Structure safety (snapshots, diff, protected files).
